title: Add device
instructions: On your phone, open <0>Devices → Show QR to pair</0> and paste the displayed data here:
vaultKeyMissing: This device has no encryption key, so it would be registered without access to the Vault. Paste the encryption key shown on the phone (Devices → Show encryption key).
vaultKeyFailed: Could not encrypt the vault key for this device: {{message}}
allowNoVaultKey: Register anyway, without Vault access (you can send the key later with "Redistribute vault key")
